'''Malau Jocaos''' was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], serving within [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. He was responsible for the planning and execution of an [[Bombing of Rialla Way|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]].<ref name="OaAI" />
